about: One list of names and the surface class each must read as, run through BOTH readers of the shape rule: tolerance_stack/feature_geometry.py's required_surface_class (tests/test_feature_geometry.py) and apps/annotate/suggestions.js's AA.requiredSurfaceClass (apps/annotate/run_tests.cjs). The rule's words are Python's and generated into the browser; the matching is written twice, and this file is what holds the two to one answer. null = no rule answers.
